name: Steel Enarme
description: Raises the shield into the school's first guard with the rim at the brow and the elbow tucked.

name: Squall Boss
description: Glides forward on bent knees behind the board with the weight kept low and even.

name: Squallbash
description: Jabs the rim's point at the throat or wrist like a hawk's beak darting from cover.

name: Pall Rim
description: Turns the board like a pinion against a cut and sweeps it up and over the shoulder.

name: Shovevow
description: Beats the rim against the opponent's weapon in a quick pinion stroke to ruin the next movement.

name: Wardverdict
description: Stoops under a swing and bashes upward with the board's face into the opponent's torso.

name: Revelation Bossrim
description: Receives a heavy blow on the angled board and returns it along the same line.

name: Demolition Backbrace
description: Sweeps the board wide in a pinion arc that clears all who crowd the bearer.

name: Revelation Face
description: Folds the board across an incoming technique and breaks its pattern as a hawk folds its wings.

name: Peerless Buffet Verdict
description: The school's defining dive in which the board drops onto the guard with the whole body behind its rim.

name: Inviolate Backboard
description: Sets the board on the guard track at the chest with the rim level and the shoulder behind it.

name: Buffetcrown
description: Opens the strike track by sliding the board out along a line that the guard never uses.

name: Spectral Ward
description: Steps so the feet stay on their own lines and neither track crosses the other.

name: Squall Shieldarm
description: Parries with the rim along the guard track and leaves the strike track free to answer.

name: Vigorenarme
description: Drives the board along the strike track into the opponent's centre while the guard stays covered.

name: Coverpledge
description: Feints a switch of tracks with the shoulders and lets the true motion follow the other line.

name: Shovepledge
description: Leans on the guard track to pin the opponent's weapon while the strike track stays ready.

name: Revelation Edgeband
description: Takes a blow on one track and sends its force out along the other.

name: Unrivaled Shoulderset
description: Presses along both tracks at once so the opponent has no safe side to retreat to.

name: Undefiled Strap
description: Closes both tracks around a technique's pattern and cancels it between the two lines.

name: Prism Edgeband
description: The school's defining posture in which guard and strike run on separate tracks without a break.

name: Steel Bossrim
description: Takes a stance with the board cupped forward like a bowl to take whatever blows arrive.

name: Shovegrace
description: Moves in a smooth line like a stream in its bed with the board following the path.

name: Steelrim
description: Taps the rim downward on a weapon wrist as the first blow settles on the board.

name: Unwavering Strap
description: Parries in a rapid turn that passes the blow along the board as water passes rapids.

name: Venerable Backboard
description: Gathers several blows into the cupped board and braces so they spend themselves in one place.

name: Facegrace
description: Meanders aside in two curving steps so the opponent's line of attack misses by a hand.

name: Sigilward
description: Pulls the opponent's weapon down with the rim like an undertow dragging a swimmer under.

name: Seasonrim
description: Shoves forward in a continuous rising pressure that lifts the opponent off the ground.

name: Radiance Enarme
description: Spills the gathered force of the cupped board back at the attacker in one rebound.

name: Buffettriumph
description: Sweeps the board across the front in a broad river-mouth arc that scatters those standing near.

name: Inviolate Boss
description: Settles the cupped board over an incoming technique until its pattern clogs and fails.

name: Rim Troth
description: The school's defining art of gathering blows in the board and sending them down the river of the arm.

name: Prism Shieldarm
description: Holds the great shield upright before the whole body with the base planted on the ground.

name: Vigorface
description: Paces forward with the great shield dragged ahead in small rhythmic steps.

name: Haemalward
description: Hammers the heavy rim down onto the opponent's guard with the weight of the whole shield.

name: Peal Face
description: Slants the great shield against a charge so its force runs along the face and past.

name: Statute Enarme
description: Anchors both feet with qi so the great shield takes a battering without moving.

name: Paramount Bash
description: Tips the great shield forward on its base so its whole weight falls on the opponent.

name: Prism Backboard
description: Takes the heaviest blow on the great shield and returns it through the base into the attacker.

name: Subtle Rim
description: Spreads a field behind the great shield that shelters comrades standing close at the bearer's back.

name: Gloomface
description: Leans the great shield and its field onto the enemy front and lowers the strength of all caught beneath.

name: Venerable Steel Backbrace
description: The school's defining rite in which the great shield becomes a standing court no enemy may enter.

name: Prism Face
description: Opens two shields to either side of the body like a hawk's paired wings spread wide.

name: Steel Shove
description: Jabs from the wing tip's rim in a snap along the line of the outstretched arm.

name: Vigorbuffet
description: Beats the feet in time with the shields' opening and closing so body and boards move as one.

name: Sacrosanct Shieldarm
description: Folds one wing across a cut and carries it off past the other shield's edge.

name: Steel Boss
description: Spreads the qi field between both shields so the cover reaches wider than either alone.

name: Thrallbash
description: Closes both shields on an arm or weapon and pinches it fast between the faces.

name: Wardtriumph
description: Rises on the toes and bashes upward with both shields on the updraft of a spread guard.

name: Eclipse Strap
description: Catches an attack in the spread wings and returns its force through both shields.

name: Artful Bossrim
description: Holds both shields at fixed angles with the field spread between them to ward the ground ahead.

name: Immaculate Edgeband
description: Beats both wings against a technique's pattern from either side and cancels its qi.

name: Heroic Demolition Bash
description: The school's defining sweep in which both wings open together and throw back all that surround them.

name: Stately Backboard
description: Raises the board polished side outward as the first guard of the sky-mirror forms.

name: Statute Edgeband
description: Stands as still as a mirror on a calm day with the board giving back every strike.

name: Commanding Ward
description: Angles the rim to throw a flash of light into the opponent's eyes at the start of a bash.

name: Squallbuffet
description: Slides sideways with the board held plumb so the opponent's cut finds only the polished face.

name: Revered Shieldarm
description: Lights the board's face with core qi so it holds firm against cuts that would crack plain wood.

name: Backbrace Covenant
description: Turns the polished face against a blow and throws it back along an angle.

name: Thunderclap Shoulderset
description: Dazzles the attacker's sight with the sky-lit face and breaks the rhythm of their stroke.

name: Haemal Shove
description: Drives the lit face forward into the opponent in a single bash backed by core qi.

name: Undefiled Boss
description: Catches a heavy blow on the lit face and returns it in the opposite direction.

name: Face Troth
description: Raises a mirror-bright ward of core qi before the board that turns aside missiles and strikes.

name: Parity Backbrace
description: Shows an incoming technique its own pattern in the lit face and causes it to unravel.

name: Consecrated Rim
description: The school's defining return in which the full core-lit face sends an attack back at the attacker.

name: Strap Troth
description: Raises the shield to the height sworn at the taking of the oath and holds it there.

name: Feather Bash
description: Strides along the sworn line in even paces with the board always toward the foe.

name: Rimtriumph
description: Raps the rim against the hand of any who reach for the line.

name: Enarme Troth
description: Parries a cut with the board while the oath is spoken aloud to steady the arm.

name: Statute Boss
description: Braces the sworn ground against a charge with qi sunk through both soles.

name: Quenched Shove
description: Shoves any who cross the sworn line back over it with a short qi-driven heave.

name: Thrall Shove
description: Hooks the rim around an intruder's weapon arm and holds it as the oath holds the line.

name: Inviolate Bossrim
description: Receives a heavy blow on the board and returns it in a single gust of force.

name: Bosscrown
description: Sweeps the board along the sworn line to push back every attacker who has reached it.

name: Immaculate Rim
description: Speaks the oath under a technique's strike and cancels its pattern by the held guard.

name: Venerable Face
description: The school's defining hold in which the sworn bearer cannot be moved from the line while the oath stands.

name: Revered Strap
description: Stands with the board facing the oncoming rush so it breaks around the bearer.

name: Silken Cover
description: Steps sideways to place the board before a comrade's exposed flank.

name: Inferno Ward
description: Strikes the first attacker who pushes past the board with the hard rim.

name: Devout Backbrace
description: Blunts a rising assault by meeting it early with the board and a steady flow of qi.

name: Peal Enarme
description: Slants the board so a blow loses force against its face and slides toward the side.

name: Rimseal
description: Beats the rim against an attacker's raised weapon and breaks the rhythm of the rush.

name: Eclipse Backboard
description: Stands against a heavy blow and returns the blow's force through the board into the striker.

name: Guileful Bossrim
description: Spreads a qi field behind the board so comrades stand sheltered from the rushing blows.

name: Gloomenarme
description: Spreads the field over the enemy host in front of the board and lowers its strength.

name: Unwavering Parity Edgeband
description: The school's defining art in which the bearer stands in front of the host and turns every assault aside.

name: Inviolate Shieldarm
description: Sets the board low and wide on open ground with the whole body behind its cover.

name: Vigorbash
description: Paces a circle on bare ground with the board turned to each side that is threatened.

name: Haemal Bash
description: Chops the rim down on the nearest attacker from behind the low cover.

name: Strap Seal
description: Parries wide with the board's edge to turn a charge from the left or the right.

name: Prism Boss
description: Rotates the guard steadily so the board covers whichever side the foe presses hardest.

name: Steel Edgeband
description: Sinks qi into the ground so the guard stays rooted against pushes from several sides.

name: Thunderclap Buffet
description: Shoves in one direction with the board to open a gap in an encircling ring of attackers.

name: Pallface
description: Scuffs dust behind the board's edge so the attackers lose sight of the bearer's next move.

name: Sacrosanct Face
description: Receives a crushing blow and returns it with the board along the ground-braced line.

name: Noble Bash
description: Sweeps the board round in a low ring that throws back all who press close.

name: Sigil Backboard
description: Holds the guard against a technique until the pattern of its qi dissolves on the board.

name: Steel Shieldarm
description: The school's defining form in which a bearer on open ground holds against attack from every side.

name: Sacrosanct Enarme
description: Lifts the board to meet an oncoming blow at the moment the oath is spoken.

name: Squallstrap
description: Steps in the direction an attack is travelling so the board meets it before it gathers force.

name: Squallface
description: Flicks the rim at the opponent's wrist as the board turns past a stroke.

name: Enshrined Backbrace
description: Slants the board to catch an attack's force and carry it along the surface.

name: Buffetbanner
description: Bashes in the same motion that turns a blow aside so the force goes with the board.

name: Thrall Cover
description: Draws the rim across the opponent's weapon and pins it where the oath's qi holds it.

name: Venombuffet
description: Beats a steady rhythm on the opponent's weapon until the attacker's form comes undone.

name: Faithful Rim
description: Gathers the force of the attack in the board and throws the whole blow back at its source.

name: Season Shove
description: Advances behind the board with steady qi pressure that drives the opponent step by step backward.

name: Sigil Strap
description: Turns the board against the pattern of a technique and scatters its qi into the open air.

name: Inviolate Radiance Bossrim
description: The school's defining art in which the sworn bearer returns the wind of any attack to its source.

name: Statute Backbrace
description: Takes a stance on a single long bearing with the board square along the line.

name: Ward Solace
description: Steps only along the chosen line so the feet never leave the bearing that the board holds.

name: Steel Cover
description: Strikes along the bearing with the rim so the blow arrives where the guard already stands.

name: Statute Backboard
description: Extends the qi field along the bearing so blows on any part of the line are braced.

name: Inviolate Edgeband
description: Parries with the board without moving the stance off the line of the bearing.

name: Vaunted Cover
description: Drives the shoulder through the board along the bearing into the opponent's centre.

name: Eclipse Rim
description: Rebounds a heavy blow along the bearing line and sends it back through the board.

name: Parity Face
description: Holds the guard on the bearing with a qi ward that stretches across the field behind the board.

name: Statute Shieldarm
description: Holds the bearing unmoved under a technique until its qi pattern comes apart.

name: Faithful Enarme Covenant
description: The school's defining form in which one bearing is held across a whole field by shield and qi.

name: Stately Rim
description: Raises the board beneath the open sky with the oath spoken to the horizon.

name: Prism Bossrim
description: Holds still with the board lifted so the open sky shows over the rim.

name: Vigorstrap
description: Steps along the horizon's line with the board toward whichever side presses closest.

name: Steelbash
description: Taps the rim against the weapon of the first attacker to reach the oath-ground.

name: Bossrim Covenant
description: Holds the board with core qi so it takes heavy blows without cracking or shifting.

name: Edgeband Vow
description: Slants the board to the open sky and sends a blow upward and away.

name: Steelbuffet
description: Shoves with a pulse of core qi through the board so the push carries far past contact.

name: Peremptory Shoulderset
description: Leans the board on an intruder's weapon and fixes it to the ground by the weight of the oath.

name: Radiance Boss
description: Takes the whole blow on the board and returns it into the open sky and the attacker.

name: Wily Shieldarm
description: Spreads the core's field over the sworn ground so intruders on it are slowed and weakened.

name: Faithful Face
description: Lifts the board to the open sky and lets a technique's pattern dissolve against the formed core.

name: Steel Backboard
description: The school's defining hold in which the formed core keeps the oath-guard unbroken under the open sky.
